attributes.action: The Right to Survive - The chance to choose before cancer chooses you.
attributes.additional_details: Financial education is important & it's commonly known this curriculum area needs improvement. Show adults that for the price of a coffee, that if they, their partner or child were diagnosed with cancer, they could receive the best available treatment worldwide. Currently not marketed as is regulated product, with no one widely promoting it. Promote it at 18, 1st child or when tax liable. Think bigger. Promote it. Reduce the strain on the NHS. Reduce GoFundMe. So many lives could be saved.
attributes.background: The current financial strain on both the NHS, Government and society combined can be removed with education and promotion of currently paid for insurance policies with additional benefits of world wide cancer treatment for adults and children. We demand improved financial education across the UK.

rejection.details: We don't really know what you are asking the Government to do - it doesn't come across clearly in your petition text.
